entries.reason: Source-specific review: packages/uta-broker-alpaca/src/index.ts:1-1: Line 1 is the sole import and points at the legacy AlpacaBroker class. services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/alpaca/AlpacaBroker.ts:101-124: legacy class implements IBroker and parses raw brokerConfig in fromConfig. Current target: Keep the Alpaca pack optional and pack-local. SDK objects, credentials, native request/response decoding, and stream/query lifecycles stay inside the pack. A provider-local layer or HOF may acquire resources; it is not a universal broker object, and unsupported sibling leaves are absent rather than returned as Unsupported. Scope is declared by the leaf: public data uses Public/data scope or its exact provider scope, while AccountScope is required only for account-owned facts or controlled trading effects; no default account or subaccount is invented. Contract disposition: reframed under K01/K02/K07. Preserved behavior: Keep lazy SDK loading: importing the core without an Alpaca pack must still work. Keep paper/live as separate operational environments, but replace the unverified class-level assumption with observed account/environment evidence. Do not preserve the legacy IBroker mutation path once this module is authoritative. Open empirical obligations remain explicit: Alpaca's SDK surface exposes UUID/client-order-id lookup paths, but this source and the completed adapter design do not prove server-side idempotency or retention across restart; until versioned native conformance records a dedupe window, keep ObserveBeforeRetry with persisted DispatchIdentity/ClientOrderId and never issue a second create-order request.
